name: NovelAI Image SDK v0.2.0
body:
Closes the FFI gap that kept the bindings from matching the Rust core: every generation option now crosses the boundary, and the language bindings gain buffered real-time generation.

## Added

- **Every generation option crosses FFI.** The boundaries exposed a 24-field subset of the core's 45-field `GenerationRequest`. Twenty-two fields were missing: `dynamic_thresholding`, `smea`, `smea_dynamic`, `auto_smea`, `add_original_image`, `controlnet_strength`, `controlnet_condition`, `controlnet_model`, `reference_strengths`, `character_prompts`, `use_coords`, `use_order`, `legacy_uc`, `normalize_reference_strengths`, `deliberate_euler_ancestral_bug`, `prefer_brownian`, `skip_cfg_above_sigma`, `legacy`, `legacy_v3_extend`, `inpaint_img2img_strength` and `straight_alpha`, plus `reference_information` on the Node side. Multi-character composition, SMEA control, ControlNet conditioning, and the V3/V5 compatibility switches now work from Python, Kotlin, Swift, Node.js, Go, C#, and C++.
- **Buffered real-time generation.** `collect_generation(request, max_events)` drains the V4+ / V5 event stream into a list. UniFFI has no streaming export; Node already had `collectGeneration`.

## Changed

- The UniFFI record converts through `novelai_image_sdk::spec`, the same mapping the napi boundary uses. The hand-written second conversion is gone, so a field added to the core spec reaches both boundaries.

## Compatibility

- Additive. The new record fields default to `None`, so existing constructors and calls compile and run unchanged. Python's generated `GenerationRequest.__init__` keeps the new fields keyword-optional.
